features.name: Natural Armor
features.description: When you aren't wearing armor, your base AC equals 11 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier. The Constitution modifier added to this AC can't exceed +5. You can use this AC if armor you wear would give you a lower AC, and you can still gain the benefit of a shield.

features.name: Claws
features.description: You can use your claws to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier slashing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: You can breathe air and water, and have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

features.name: Nature's Intuition
features.description: You gain proficiency with one of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Stealth, or Survival.

features.name: Shell Defense
features.description: You can withdraw into your shell as an action. Until you emerge, you gain a +4 bonus to your AC, and you have advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws. While in your shell, you are prone, your speed is 0 and can’t increase, you have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, you can’t take reactions, and the only action you can take is a bonus action to emerge from your shell.
